title: Continuation order: PostgreSQL depth, optional GIS acceleration, then MySQL outbound
summary: The planned continuation is PostgreSQL parameter arrays, cancellation, nonblocking execution, COPY streaming and pipeline mode; then an optional Foreign Runtime GeoPackage/sqlite/spatial accelerator while preserving the pure-ooRexx reader; then a MySQL/MariaDB outbound native backend using the same common contracts. Rich structured results should eventually flow directly into Database Core rather than being rendered to compatibility text first.
procedure: Implement PostgreSQL parameter arrays via Foreign Runtime pointer/buffer machinery and PQexecParams/PQsendQueryParams; do not interpolate SQL.
Add cancellation with explicit session ownership and evidence.
Add COPY source/sink streaming with backpressure and lifetime semantics.
Add pipeline mode only after version/capability qualification.
Add optional GeoPackage Foreign Runtime acceleration, keeping the pure-ooRexx path intact.
Add MySQL/MariaDB outbound native client backend under the same capability/session/result contract.
Move Database Core consumers toward structured results where compatible.
invariants: Do not sacrifice the portable GIS path for acceleration.
Do not add provider-specific shortcuts to the common contract unless represented as explicit capabilities/extensions.
Do not silently replay work across backend implementations after acquisition.

provenance.claim: The continuation order is PostgreSQL depth, optional GIS acceleration preserving pure ooRexx, then MySQL/MariaDB outbound native client.
